title: When you see BIGTIME moon and remember your 1‑minute candle obsession
content: Seeing BIGTIME +81% is like that one friend who always shows up late to the party – you’re thrilled, then you realize you’ve been staring at the 1‑min chart for hours, sipping cold coffee, and your BTC dip just whispered, “Nice try.”
lesson: If a token’s rocket looks faster than your coffee cooling, step back – leverage love is a short‑term fling, not a relationship.
question: Who else spent the last 3 AM checking the 1‑min chart and then blamed the dip on “bad Wi‑Fi”? Be honest 👇
